outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (Bayley Scales of Infant Development III)
cohort: The study included 8 infants of mothers with gestational diabetes (IMGD) and 16 healthy infants.
finding: Infants of mothers with gestational diabetes (IMGD) showed greater mean body weight and height, significantly lower language composite scores, and significantly lower serum BDNF levels at 12 months of age compared to non-IMGD.
